cleanup_reuse.decision: Exact previously reviewed process block; no new process qualification claimed.
cleanup_reuse.facts: One isolated Python child in a fresh process session. wait4 polling retains exit/signal and usage; timeout/wait error enters finally, kills the process group, tolerates the exit/kill race and attempts the final reap. Cleanup failure or unreaped state prevents completion.

cost_and_failure_scope.costs: Receipt retains nested child wall, child user/system CPU and RSS, plus observer run-entry through post-run custody/output-check wall. Interpreter/import startup, preparation/review and final receipt serialization are excluded. This is not lifetime cost.
cost_and_failure_scope.postlaunch_failure: Successful completion requires reaped exit zero, no timeout/process/read error, unchanged pins/gate and complete valid output contract. Other branches retain FAILED and partial files when filesystem operations remain available.
cost_and_failure_scope.prelaunch_failure: Before START, refusal is raised to the root caller; root must retain outer stdout/stderr/exit. Missing-gate evidence demonstrates this branch only.
cost_and_failure_scope.registered_consumer_limits: Unchanged 2000000 token-state and 60-second soft bounds; 180-second outer process containment does not change them.

identity_closure.source_pin_rules: Required and root-added pins reject unequal duplicates; all pins, observer, helper, contract, consumer freeze, runtime and accepted-review files are compared before and after the child. Gate bytes are separately compared after the child.

limits: Source readiness is not an execution gate or proof of the unopened accepted-gate whole-observer run.
No new tests, imports of reviewed modules, gates, native/export/extractor/cut/alias/learner execution or historical control replay occurred.
Native prefix/artifact authority remains the independently accepted upstream evidence; no corpus or trace bodies were opened for this review.
No serving utility, held-out result, aggregate result or novelty claim follows.
method: Full observer/output/control source read; static AST only; exact metadata/source/receipt/log/fixture hashes and donor byte comparison. No reviewed-module imports, executions or actual research input interpretation.

once_only_launch.authority_boundary: Root must supply the accepted-review descriptors and gate. Review files are byte-bound authority supplied by root, not reinterpreted as self-issued permission. Preserve the observation directory after any attempted launch.
once_only_launch.decision: Accepted for fixed root-gated single launch.
once_only_launch.facts: Exact request/runtime/argv/cwd/output/observation and integer 180-second outer timeout are checked. Authorization names all three accepted reviews. Atomic creation of the previously absent observation directory occurs before the single Popen site; there is no retry. Existing output or observation entries refuse.

output_contract_alignment.decision: Matches accepted consumer-v3 emitted output shapes; no candidate-semantic or native revalidation claimed.
output_contract_alignment.facts: ENUMERATED, UNKNOWN_INTERFACE and TRACE_UNUSABLE require matching ROOT records. Resource-unreached and excluded rows must not have extra ROOT files. Completion requires all 128 ordered positions, unique labels, exact child PID/request/authority/P1 identities and custody flags. P1-CONTRACTS bytes are bound; TRACE_UNUSABLE requires P1_retained true. Nonregular entries, missing processed files, differing payloads and extra files prevent completion.
output_contract_alignment.partial_failure: Readable partial regular files are inventoried before population validation. A consistent partial AUDIT_FAILED record cannot complete. Missing or unreadable outputs fail; existing files are not removed. An inspection exception is retained explicitly, although it can prevent a complete file-hash inventory.
output_contract_alignment.whole_parent_boundary: Full 4323-contract preservation follows the unchanged accepted consumer validation/write path; this observer checks the resulting P1 file identity and does not recount or requalify native contracts.

retained_controls.composition: Eight authored output controls plus one exact cleanup-source comparison.
retained_controls.startup_boundary: The exact -I -S -B observer command from /tmp reaches missing gate at line 47. It does not reach output-helper import, accepted-gate validation, Popen or consumer startup. Static sibling resolution and authored helper controls cover the helper separately.
